ESIC University V INTERNATIONAL WEEK
EMPOWERING MINDS, BUILDING FUTURES
April 7–11, 2025 | 09:30 AM – 2:00 PM
Thanks to the BIP initiative, it’s completely free for our participating professors!

報名網址：https://reurl.cc/nq93Me

Daily Breakdown: A Transformative Journey
Day 1: "We Don’t Start from Scratch: We Are People"
Focus: Reconnecting with your identity beyond titles and tasks.
•	Activities: Deviceless discussions, reflective exercises, and storytelling.
•	Outputs:
o	A reinvented purpose statement for your teaching journey.
o	A personalized roadmap for new challenges.
________________________________________
Day 2: "Organizing Your Office: What and Who Matters?"
Focus: Analyzing shifts in education and understanding modern learners.
•	Activities: Collaborative mapping of student motivations, generational changes, and institutional needs.
•	Outputs:
o	A problem-needs map for your teaching context.
o	A clear achievement horizon (goals aligned with today’s learners).
________________________________________
Day 3: "Reinventing Teaching: The Infallible Method"
Focus: Co-creating innovative methodologies.
•	Activities: Brainstorming sessions, sharing global best practices, and designing a "dream" approach.
•	Outputs:
o	A blueprint for a unique teaching methodology—yours to own.
________________________________________
Day 4: "From Idea to Reality: Your Formula for Success"
Focus: Grounding creativity into actionable plans.
•	Activities: Prototyping, peer feedback, and refining your method.
•	Outputs:
o	A detailed guide to implement your new methodology.
________________________________________
Day 5: "Go to Market: Test Your Invention"
Focus: [Classified – Surprise Challenges Await]
•	Activities: Secret missions, real-world simulations, and collaborative trials.
•	Outputs:
o	A transformed version of YOU: confident, innovative, and ready to inspire.
________________________________________
Outcomes for Participants:
•	A renewed sense of purpose and clarity about your role in education.
•	A custom teaching methodology to engage modern learners.
•	Resilience tools to thrive in evolving academic landscapes.
•	Global connections with like-minded educators.
